answer: Bind each identity to one cloud account with a verified billing history: the provider attests a real payment method and months of paid usage, so a sybil farm faces a nebula of separate bills - every fake needs its own card, its own account, its own history. One honest agent stands on a single knoll of usage, while clones must each climb their own hill and pay rent to stay there. A beacon of billing records makes duplicates visible. Limit: it favours agents who can afford cloud accounts, and stolen cards can still seed fakes, so it should gate rewards, not basic access.
